testedVersions: PowerShell 7.6.10 Windows with mocked Az.Accounts 5.5.5, Az.Resources 10.2.3, Az.OperationalInsights 3.4.1; Pester 5.7.1
prerequisites: PowerShell Core 7.4+; documented Az module versions installed separately; existing authorized public Azure context for the declared tenant and subscription.
limits: Synthetic validation only. No subscription switching, cross-tenant delegation, Azure Stack, sovereign clouds, data plane, logs, workspace keys or tags. Exact ARM paths only.

permissions: Microsoft.Resources/subscriptions/read for the exact subscription (required for all sections).
sections.refreshStrategy: One verified subscription; never list or switch subscriptions.
limits: NotApplicable when only a resource group was requested. Visible name and subscription state, never billing or identity details.

permissions: Subscription identity read plus Microsoft.Resources/subscriptions/resourceGroups/read in the requested scope.
sections.refreshStrategy: Read visible groups within the verified subscription, or the single verified group.
limits: Supported group names are ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, parentheses and period (not final). Incomplete and out-of-scope rows are not published.

permissions: Subscription identity read; Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/read within scope. Group scope additionally requires a direct resource group read.
sections.refreshStrategy: List workspace control-plane metadata in the exact subscription or group.
limits: No queries, events, tables, shared keys, retention contents or diagnostic records. Uncollected parent groups remain typed references.
